privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: EcoScan is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
privacy.dataCollectionText: EcoScan collects minimal, non-personally identifiable information:
privacy.dataItem2: Timestamp of when reports are submitted
privacy.dataItem3: General bin location data (as configured by administrators)
privacy.noPersonalDataText: We do NOT collect any personally identifiable information (PII). We do not collect your name, email address, phone number, IP address, device identifiers, or any other information that could be used to identify you personally. All bin status reports are submitted anonymously.
privacy.cookiesText: EcoScan uses local storage to save your language preference and administrator authentication tokens. With your consent, we use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site. Google Analytics collects anonymized data (IP addresses are anonymized). You can decline analytics cookies when prompted.

hero.eyebrow: Smart waste management ready for pilot deployment
hero.title: Real-time bin monitoring for modern cities
hero.subtitle: EcoScan is a pilot-ready platform that helps municipalities manage waste bins with modern technology. Track fill levels, optimize collection routes, and engage citizens through QR reporting — a complete foundation for smarter waste operations.
hero.metric1Desc: Color-coded bin status at a glance

heroCard.title: Platform capabilities
heroCard.item1: Interactive map dashboard with real-time bin statuses
heroCard.item2: API keys and webhooks for seamless integrations
heroCard.item3: Route optimization with Google Maps integration
heroCard.item5: QR code system for citizen-powered reporting

problem.title: Challenges we address
problem.subtitle: Waste operations often rely on fixed schedules, manual inspections, and fragmented data. The result: overflowing bins, inefficient routes, and limited visibility across operations.
problem.card1Desc: Bins overflow between scheduled pickups, creating hygiene issues and citizen complaints.
problem.card2Desc: Management lacks unified visibility into bin status, vendor performance, and budget impact.
problem.card3Desc: Fixed schedules waste fuel and labor when crews visit half-empty bins.

solution.title: How EcoScan works
solution.subtitle: A practical system combining citizen engagement with operational visibility — designed to scale from pilot to city-wide deployment.
solution.step1Desc: Generate QR codes for each bin. Citizens scan to report fill levels instantly — no app download required. A practical way to engage communities in waste management.
solution.step2Desc: View all bins on an interactive map with color-coded status indicators. Filter, search, and plan collection routes from a single interface.
solution.step3Desc: The system accepts sensor data for automated readings. Same API, ready to integrate hardware when you expand beyond citizen reporting.

capabilities.title: Platform features
capabilities.subtitle: Core capabilities ready for pilot deployment, with a clear path to production scale.
capabilities.card1Desc: Generate secure API keys with scope-based access control. Configure webhooks to push real-time bin status updates to your existing systems — fleet management, GIS platforms, or custom analytics tools.
capabilities.card2Desc: View all bins on Google Maps with color-coded status indicators. Create optimized collection routes through multiple bins with turn-by-turn directions. Export data to CSV for external analysis.
capabilities.card3Desc: QR code scanning enables residents to report bin status instantly — no app download required. Multi-language support (English, Czech, German) ensures broad accessibility across diverse communities.

advantages.title: Why choose EcoScan
advantages.subtitle: Modern cloud architecture designed for municipal requirements — from pilot testing to production deployment.
advantages.adv1Desc: Serverless infrastructure scales automatically from a single district to regional deployments without infrastructure changes.
advantages.adv2Desc: API-first design connects with existing systems: fleet management, GIS platforms, vendor portals, and analytics tools.
advantages.adv3Desc: Infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and secure authentication follow industry best practices.
advantages.adv4Desc: Built-in audit trails, role-based access, and operational reporting support governance and compliance requirements.
advantages.archItem1: Event-driven processing with API Gateway, message queues, and serverless functions
advantages.archItem2: Managed database with infrastructure deployed via Terraform
advantages.archItem3: Real-time updates and third-party integration patterns included

roadmap.title: Development roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Current capabilities and planned enhancements for production deployments.
roadmap.phase1Item1: Admin dashboard with interactive map and route optimization
roadmap.phase1Item2: API keys management with scope-based access control
roadmap.phase1Item4: CSV data export and multi-language support (EN, CS, DE)
roadmap.phase1Item5: QR-based citizen reporting with batch printing
roadmap.phase1Item6: Secure authentication with password reset flow
roadmap.phase2Item1: IoT sensor integration and hardware partnerships
roadmap.phase2Item4: Mobile apps for field crews and citizens
roadmap.phase3Item1: AI-optimized collection routes with machine learning
roadmap.phase3Item3: Fleet management and vendor performance tracking
roadmap.phase3Item4: Public transparency dashboards and open data APIs
